summary: Virgin Galactic filed an 8-K reporting final court approval of a derivative lawsuit settlement. On August 14, 2026, the U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of New York approved settlements in two consolidated derivative actions. Insurers will pay $2.75 million to the company, which retains half, with the rest going to plaintiffs' counsel for fees. All related claims are released with no finding of wrongdoing. This is a routine litigation update, not a special-situation transaction. No deal terms apply; watch for any subsequent corporate developments.
